workbench.title: 工作台

tools.name: account_create
tools.title: 添加 Codex 账户
tools.description: 准备临时官方登录目录；成功核验后才登记账户，不自动设为默认。

tools.name: account_login
tools.title: 登录 Codex 账户
tools.description: 打开官方 OpenAI 登录页面，登录完成后自动核验账户状态。

tools.name: account_status
tools.title: 核验 Codex 账户
tools.description: 读取官方登录状态和额度，并登记已确认的账户主体。

tools.name: account_default
tools.title: 设置默认账户
tools.description: 设置已登记且身份核验通过的默认账户；所有会话下一次请求使用该账户。

tools.name: open_workbench
tools.title: 工作台
tools.description: 打开只读工作台，不创建、修改或执行业务对象。

tools.name: workbench_state
tools.title: 读取工作台
tools.description: 按视图读取后台更新的公开 JSON 快照，不在页面请求中访问来源。

tools.name: skill_detail
tools.title: 读取技能详情
tools.description: 只读展示官方已发现技能的能力信息。

tools.name: model_list
tools.title: 读取模型目录
tools.description: 读取已经登记的模型与验证快照，不发起验证。

tools.name: model_detail
tools.title: 读取模型详情
tools.description: 读取指定模型的公开配置与保险库条目引用。

tools.name: credential_list
tools.title: 读取配置目录
tools.description: 仅展示非秘密目录与匹配当前修订的结构索引。

tools.name: credential_details
tools.title: 读取单条配置
tools.description: 返回由请求浏览器临时私钥解密的单条信封，不返回明文。

tools.name: workbench_sync
tools.title: 同步工作台变化
tools.description: 按修订返回后台快照差异；刷新仅排入后台采集，失败保留最后成功数据，不返回密钥。

tools.name: module_list
tools.title: 读取工作台模块
tools.description: 读取用户可见模块目录，不公开内部成果、诊断或验收记录。

tools.name: project_list
tools.title: 读取项目概览
tools.description: 读取原生项目、分区与会话关联，不新建或改写项目。

tools.name: project_detail
tools.title: 读取项目详情
tools.description: 只读取已存在原生项目及关联会话。

tools.name: knowledge_list
tools.title: 读取知识目录
tools.description: 读取选定既有范围内的已审核知识摘要。

tools.name: knowledge_detail
tools.title: 阅读知识
tools.description: 读取指定范围内已审核且有效的知识，不创建或修改知识。

tools.name: service_list
tools.title: 读取服务目录
tools.description: 从已登记模型或当前凭证结构生成只读引用，不解密、不重新登记服务。

tools.name: service_detail
tools.title: 读取服务引用
tools.description: 读取服务来源和其关联配置引用。

tools.name: connection_list
tools.title: 读取工具连接
tools.description: 读取 MCP 配置及本地已安装插件，不进行探测、登录或安装。

tools.name: global_search
tools.title: 搜索工作台
tools.description: 搜索公开元数据与用户指定范围的知识摘要，不搜索秘密值。

tools.name: planning_create
tools.title: 创建计划任务
tools.description: 在本机计划库创建任务；不会提交、推送或创建远端任务。

tools.name: planning_update
tools.title: 更新计划任务
tools.description: 用版本号比较并更新本机任务。

tools.name: planning_start
tools.title: 启动计划任务
tools.description: 用版本号确认后启动本机任务；message_id 仅执行保存的问答消息。

tools.name: planning_stop
tools.title: 停止计划任务
tools.description: 停止本机正在运行的任务。

tools.name: planning_archive
tools.title: 归档计划任务
tools.description: 归档已结束的本机任务；重试不会再次执行 Codex。

tools.name: planning_delete
tools.title: 删除计划任务
tools.description: 用版本号确认后软删除本机任务，保留资料和执行历史。

tools.name: planning_followup
tools.title: 记录任务追问
tools.description: 只记录追问，不自动启动或执行任务。

tools.name: planning_knowledge_link
tools.title: 关联已审核知识
tools.description: 将用户明确选取的已审核知识条目关联到本机任务。

tools.name: planning_export
tools.title: 导出计划笔记
tools.description: 生成本机 Obsidian Markdown 投影；可包含任务显式关联的已审核知识，不改写权威知识。

tools.name: planning_detail
tools.title: 读取计划任务
tools.description: 读取本机任务及其运行和追问记录。

tools.name: planning_draft
tools.title: 生成计划草案
tools.description: 使用已验证的本机模型目录生成草案；失败时返回手工草案。

tools.name: planning_intake
tools.title: 识别文字任务录入
tools.description: 把文字拆为待确认的新任务、补充或问答草案；不保存或执行。

tools.name: planning_intake_save
tools.title: 保存文字任务录入
tools.description: 原子保存经确认的工作项，不会启动 Codex。

tools.name: library_upload
tools.title: 上传资料
tools.description: 将不超过 256 KiB 的 Base64 资料写入本机资料库。

tools.name: library_upload_begin
tools.title: 开始分块上传
tools.description: 为最大 32 MiB 的本机资料创建分块上传。

tools.name: library_upload_chunk
tools.title: 上传资料分块
tools.description: 写入单个 Base64 分块；偏移必须与当前上传位置一致。

tools.name: library_upload_commit
tools.title: 完成分块上传
tools.description: 校验总大小后将已上传资料写入本机资料库。

tools.name: library_link
tools.title: 关联资料
tools.description: 把已存在资料关联到本机任务。

tools.name: library_list
tools.title: 读取资料列表
tools.description: 读取本机资料元数据，不返回资料内容。

tools.name: library_content
tools.title: 读取资料分块
tools.description: 读取本机资料的 Base64 分块。

tools.name: planning_delivery
tools.title: 更新任务交付
tools.description: 在当前任务版本下更新任务卡、批注、证据或人工验收；不自动执行。

tools.name: planning_context
tools.title: 检索任务上下文
tools.description: 仅检索本任务显式关联的资料和知识。semantic=true 使用已登记外部模型；默认本地关键词。

tools.name: planning_knowledge_candidates
tools.title: 提取知识候选
tools.description: 从有效交付证据提取待审核候选，不直接写入已审核知识。

tools.name: planning_output_filter
tools.title: 整理工具输出
tools.description: 保留控制字段、错误和证据引用；可显式关闭并读取原文。

tools.name: planning_output_source
tools.title: 回取工具原文
tools.description: 读取一小时内的本机工具输出原文，可按 JSON Pointer 读取省略片段。

/* 执行记录在独立滚动区横向展开；单列时占满可用宽度。 */


/* 执行详情复用现有卡片与颜色；固定头尾，正文独立滚动。 */

#task-detail{width:min(840px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:0;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 80px #142a2833}
#task-detail[open]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.eyebrow{display:block;color:var(--green);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}


/* 状态颜色用于整列和卡片的层级关系，结果标签独立表达失败或取消。 */
[data-state="backlog"]{--state-color:#b86420;--state-tint:#fff1e2}
[data-state="ready"]{--state-color:#3566bc;--state-tint:#eaf1ff}
[data-state="running"]{--state-color:#7957bc;--state-tint:#f0e9fb}
[data-state="done"]{--state-color:#087565;--state-tint:#e5f4ee}

/* Planning has its own surfaces: account-card gradients do not apply here. */
.planning-page{--planning-border:color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 78%,var(--surface));max-width:1440px;padding:8px 0 28px}
.planning-page .card{min-width:0;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--planning-border);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:0 2px 6px #20242c03}
.planning-page>.heading{margin:0 0 28px;align-items:flex-start}
.planning-page .heading h1,.planning-board-heading h1{font-size:26px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.7px;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 6px}
.planning-page .heading p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.planning-page button,.planning-page input,.planning-page select{transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.planning-page button:focus-visible,.planning-page input:focus-visible,.planning-page select:focus-visible,.planning-page textarea:focus-visible,.planning-page summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px}
.planning-page .badge{font-size:11px;line-height:18px;padding:2px 8px;min-height:0;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.top button.brand{padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.top button.brand[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--blue)}
.top button.brand:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:6px}
.subnav.planning-dimensions{justify-content:flex-start;gap:28px;height:52px;max-width:1440px;padding:0;margin:-8px auto 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent}
.planning-dimensions button{position:relative;min-width:0;height:52px;padding:0 2px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.planning-dimensions button:hover{color:var(--ink);background:transparent}
.planning-dimensions button[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--green);background:transparent}
.planning-dimensions button[aria-current="page"]:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;background:var(--green)}
.planning-search-form{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:440px;margin-right:auto}
.planning-search-form .search{flex:1;min-width:0;background:var(--surface)}
.planning-search-form input{width:100%;min-width:0}
.planning-page>.toolbar{margin-bottom:22px}
.planning-task-text{display:block;min-width:0;white-space:normal}
.planning-task-text strong{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.planning-task-text small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.planning-readonly-tag{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.planning-readonly-notice{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--weak)}

/* Six quiet weekday hues. Past dates deliberately have no hue. */
.planning-tone-0{--day-bg:#f2f7fe;--day-accent:#507bbb}
.planning-tone-1{--day-bg:#f2f9f5;--day-accent:#55846c}
.planning-tone-2{--day-bg:#fcf9f0;--day-accent:#9a7d43}
.planning-tone-3{--day-bg:#f7f4fc;--day-accent:#8670aa}
.planning-tone-4{--day-bg:#fcf4f7;--day-accent:#ab6f88}
.planning-tone-5{--day-bg:#f1f6f7;--day-accent:#61858c}
.planning-calendar-toolbar{gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px}
.planning-calendar-toolbar>*{order:0}
.planning-calendar-toolbar>button{order:0;flex:0 0 auto}
.planning-calendar-toolbar>.select{order:0;flex:0 1 auto}
.planning-calendar-toolbar .select{min-width:180px;max-width:300px;margin-right:auto;background:var(--surface)}
.planning-calendar-toolbar .select select{max-width:100%;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.planning-calendar-toolbar>button{min-width:34px;min-height:34px;padding:5px 9px;background:var(--surface)}
.planning-month-label{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-left:12px;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.planning-calendar-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 248px;gap:22px;align-items:start}
.planning-month-grid{min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);overflow:auto}
.planning-weekdays,.planning-days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));min-width:650px}
.planning-weekdays{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.planning-weekdays span{padding:14px 8px;text-align:center;background:var(--day-bg);color:var(--day-accent);font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.planning-day{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:132px;padding:9px 6px;background:var(--day-bg);border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.planning-day:nth-child(7n){border-right:0}
.planning-day:nth-last-child(-n+7){border-bottom:0}
.planning-day.outside{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--day-bg) 50%,var(--surface))}
.planning-day.outside time{color:var(--muted)}
.planning-day.today{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #638cba}
.planning-day>header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;margin-bottom:9px;padding:0 2px}
.planning-day time{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--day-accent);font-size:12px;font-weight:550;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.planning-day.today time{color:var(--blue);background:var(--surface);font-weight:700}
.planning-day>header button{min-height:26px;width:26px;padding:3px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--day-accent);opacity:0}
.planning-day:hover>header button,.planning-day:focus-within>header button{opacity:1}
.planning-day>header button:hover{background:var(--surface);color:var(--blue)}
.planning-day>header button .icon{width:14px;height:14px}
.planning-day-readonly{display:grid;place-items:center;width:26px;height:26px;color:#a1a7af}
.planning-day-readonly .icon{width:11px;height:11px}
.planning-day-items{display:grid;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.planning-calendar-item{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:31px;max-width:100%;padding:6px 7px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:11px;line-height:17px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid #20242c08;border-left:3px solid var(--task-accent,var(--day-accent));border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #20242c03}
.planning-calendar-item:hover{border-color:var(--task-accent,var(--day-accent));box-shadow:0 2px 5px #20242c08}
.planning-calendar-item .badge{margin-left:5px;padding:0 4px;font-size:9px;line-height:15px}
.planning-day-items>details{min-width:0;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.planning-day-items>details>summary{cursor:pointer;padding:4px 2px;border-radius:4px}
.planning-day-items>details[open] .planning-calendar-item{margin-top:6px}
.planning-day.past,.planning-day.past.outside{background:#f0f1f3;color:#90959d}
.planning-day.past time,.planning-day.past .planning-day-readonly{color:#979da5}
.planning-day.past .planning-calendar-item,.planning-day.past .badge{color:#7d8590;background:#e9ebee;border-color:#dde0e4;box-shadow:none}
.planning-day.past .planning-calendar-item{border-left-color:#b8bec6}
.planning-day.past .planning-calendar-item:hover{background:#e2e5e9;border-color:#b8bec6}
.planning-unplanned{padding:20px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--planning-border);border-radius:14px;min-width:0}
.planning-unplanned h2{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.planning-unplanned .count{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);padding:2px 7px;background:var(--weak);border-radius:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.planning-unplanned>article{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:15px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--planning-border);min-width:0}
.planning-unplanned>article>div{flex:1 1 100%;min-width:0}
.planning-unplanned strong{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.planning-unplanned small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:5px}
.planning-unplanned article button{flex:0 0 26px;width:26px;min-height:26px;margin-left:auto;padding:4px;border:0;background:var(--weak)}
.planning-unplanned>p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;margin:0;color:var(--muted)}

/* Project identity stays stable across the cards, calendar and task board. */
.planning-color-0{--task-accent:#5a7dbc;--task-soft:#edf2fb}
.planning-color-1{--task-accent:#4b9482;--task-soft:#edf7f3}
.planning-color-2{--task-accent:#ae874b;--task-soft:#faf4e9}
.planning-color-3{--task-accent:#9575b9;--task-soft:#f5effa}
.planning-color-4{--task-accent:#b7768c;--task-soft:#fcf0f4}
.planning-color-5{--task-accent:#5e99ac;--task-soft:#edf6fa}
.planning-color-6{--task-accent:#819153;--task-soft:#f2f6e9}
.planning-color-7{--task-accent:#ad7a5f;--task-soft:#faf1eb}
.planning-project-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(310px,1fr));gap:20px}
.planning-page .planning-project-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:24px;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.planning-project-card:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-accent) 30%,var(--line));box-shadow:0 5px 18px #20242c07}
.planning-project-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px}
.planning-project-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0}
.planning-project-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--task-soft);color:var(--task-accent)}
.planning-project-icon .icon{width:18px;height:18px}
.planning-project-card h2{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:-.1px;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.planning-project-heading>.badge{flex:0 0 auto;margin-top:7px}
.planning-project-description{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:16px 0 26px}
.planning-project-progress{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.planning-project-progress strong{font-size:28px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-1px;color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.planning-project-card progress{display:block;width:100%;height:5px;accent-color:var(--task-accent);margin:0 0 24px;border:0;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--weak)}
.planning-project-card progress::-webkit-progress-bar{background:var(--weak);border-radius:99px}
.planning-project-card progress::-webkit-progress-value{background:var(--task-accent);border-radius:99px}
.planning-project-card progress::-moz-progress-bar{background:var(--task-accent);border-radius:99px}
.planning-project-counts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.planning-project-counts>span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.7;white-space:normal}
.planning-project-counts strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--status-color,var(--ink));font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.planning-project-card footer{display:flex;margin-top:22px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--planning-border)}
.planning-project-card footer button{justify-content:space-between;width:100%;padding:0;min-height:28px;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.planning-project-card footer button:hover{color:var(--task-accent)}
.planning-project-card footer .icon{width:15px;height:15px}

/* Reset native button layout: a task is a vertical, wrapping card. */
.planning-board-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:24px}
.planning-board-heading p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:12px}
.planning-board-heading button{padding:0;min-height:28px;margin-bottom:16px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.planning-board-heading button:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.planning-board-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:16px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.planning-board-scroll{overflow-x:auto;padding:0 0 12px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.planning-kanban{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(225px,1fr));gap:14px;min-width:1180px;align-items:stretch}
.planning-kanban-column{min-width:0;padding:14px 10px;background:#f0f2f5;border:1px solid var(--planning-border);border-radius:12px;--column-color:#939eae}
.planning-kanban-column[data-status="pending"]{--column-color:#b38c50}
.planning-kanban-column[data-status="running"]{--column-color:#628ac7}
.planning-kanban-column[data-status="completed"]{--column-color:#60a28b}
.planning-kanban-column[data-status="attention"]{--column-color:#bb7f76}
.planning-kanban-column>header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:2px 4px 16px}
.planning-kanban-column h2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.planning-kanban-column h2:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--column-color)}
.planning-kanban-column .count{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-left:auto}
.planning-kanban-cards{display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start;min-height:290px}
.planning-kanban-task{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:0;padding:16px;text-align:left;white-space:normal;border:1px solid var(--planning-border);border-left:3px solid var(--task-accent);border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 2px 3px #20242c03}
.planning-kanban-task:hover{background:var(--surface);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--task-accent) 45%,var(--line));border-left-color:var(--task-accent);box-shadow:0 4px 12px #20242c09}
.planning-task-card-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px}
.planning-kanban-task>strong{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.planning-kanban-task>p{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;margin:8px 0 16px;line-height:1.7;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.planning-task-card-meta{display:grid;gap:5px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.planning-task-card-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:14px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid var(--planning-border);font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.planning-task-card-foot .icon{width:13px;height:13px}
.planning-column-empty{margin:0;padding:32px 10px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#929aa6;border:1px dashed #d8dde5;border-radius:8px}

/* Four primary metrics, then four compact status metrics. */
.planning-stat-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:0 0 24px}
.planning-period-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;margin-right:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--weak)}
.planning-period-tabs button{min-width:44px;min-height:30px;padding:5px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;font-size:12px}
.planning-period-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #20242c12;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.planning-stat-controls>label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.planning-stat-controls input{min-height:34px;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:inherit}
.planning-stat-controls>button{min-height:34px;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--surface)}
.planning-stat-controls>strong{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-left:6px}
.planning-stat-controls>.select{margin-left:auto;min-width:160px;max-width:280px;background:var(--surface)}

/* 无状态的只读列表渲染积木；调用方负责提供展示上下文。 */
(()=>{
 'use strict';

 function createReadonlyPrimitives({escape,icon}){
  if(typeof escape!=='function'||typeof icon!=='function')throw Error('只读渲染依赖无效');
  const values=items=>Array.isArray(items)?items:[];
  return {
   options(items,value,empty){
    return `<option value="">${escape(empty)}</option>`+values(items)
     .map(item=>`<option value="${escape(item.id)}" ${item.id===value?'selected':''}>${escape(item.name||item.title||item.id)}</option>`)
     .join('');
   },
   select(id,label,content){
    return `<label class="select"><span class="sr-only">${escape(label)}</span><select id="${escape(id)}">${content}</select>${icon('chevron-down')}</label>`;
   },
   listCount(items,unit){
    return `<span class="count" role="status">${values(items).length} ${escape(unit)}</span>`;
   },
   search(page,query){
    return `<label class="search">${icon('search')}<span class="sr-only">搜索${escape(page)}</span><input id="query" placeholder="搜索${escape(page)}" value="${escape(query)}" autocomplete="off"></label>`;
   },
   empty(text='暂无数据'){
    return `<div class="empty">${icon('inbox')}<p>${escape(text)}</p></div>`;
   },
   toolbar(...content){
    return `<div class="toolbar">${content.filter(Boolean).join('')}</div>`;
   }
  };
 }

 window.createWorkbenchReadonlyPrimitives=createReadonlyPrimitives;
})();

/** 只替换增量中的条目，保留未变化对象引用；版本不匹配时拒绝拼接。 */
function applySync(cached,response){
 if(response.unchanged){if(!cached||cached.revision!==response.revision)throw Error('缓存版本已失效');return cached;}
 if(response.reset){if(!response.data||typeof response.data!=='object')throw Error('同步数据无效');return {revision:response.revision,data:response.data};}
 if(!cached||cached.revision!==response.base_revision)throw Error('缓存版本已失效');
 const data={...cached.data},patch=response.patch;
 if(!patch||typeof patch!=='object')throw Error('同步数据无效');

 for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(patch.set||{}))Object.defineProperty(data,key,{value,enumerable:true,writable:true,configurable:true});
 for(const [key,change] of Object.entries(patch.collections||{})){
  const values=new Map(A(data[key]).map(item=>[item[change.key],item]));
  for(const id of A(change.remove))values.delete(id);
  for(const item of A(change.upsert))values.set(item[change.key],item);
  const order=change.order??[...values.keys()];
  if(!Array.isArray(order)||order.some(id=>!values.has(id)))throw Error('同步集合无效');

function configType(x){return x.service_type||x.kind||'unknown';}
function configTypeLabel(x){return x.service_type_label||KINDS[x.kind]||'通用配置';}
function filteredConfigurations(data,folder,kind,query){const descendants=foldersIn(A(data.folders),folder),q=String(query||'').toLocaleLowerCase();return newestRecords(A(data.entries).filter(x=>(!folder||descendants.has(x.folder_id))&&(!kind||configType(x)===kind)&&(!q||[entryTitle(x),x.label,x.name,x.id,configTypeLabel(x),folderPath(data.folders,x.folder_id),...A(x.tags)].join(' ').toLocaleLowerCase().includes(q))));}
function folderTree(){const all=A(s.data.folders),byId=new Map(all.map(f=>[f.id,f])),seen=new Set(),childrenById=new Map(),counts=new Map();
 for(const f of all){const siblings=childrenById.get(f.parent_id)||[];siblings.push(f);childrenById.set(f.parent_id,siblings);}
 for(const entry of A(s.data.entries)){let id=entry.folder_id;const visited=new Set();while(id&&byId.has(id)&&!visited.has(id)){visited.add(id);counts.set(id,(counts.get(id)||0)+1);id=byId.get(id).parent_id;}}
 function branch(f,depth){if(seen.has(f.id))return '';seen.add(f.id);const children=A(childrenById.get(f.id)).filter(x=>!seen.has(x.id)),closed=s.collapsedFolders.has(f.id);const count=s.data.facets?.folder_counts?.[f.id]??counts.get(f.id)??0;
 const row=`<div class="directory-row" style="--depth:${Math.min(depth,12)};--folder-color:${color(f.color)}">${children.length?`<button class="directory-toggle" id="folder-toggle-${E(f.id)}" data-folder-toggle="${E(f.id)}" aria-label="${closed?'展开':'收起'} ${E(f.name)}" aria-expanded="${!closed}">${I(closed?'chevron-right':'chevron-down')}</button>`:'<span class="directory-spacer"></span>'}<button class="folder ${s.folder===f.id?'active':''}" id="folder-${E(f.id)}" data-folder="${E(f.id)}" aria-pressed="${s.folder===f.id}"><span>${E(f.name)}</span><small>${count}</small></button></div>`;
 const nested=children.map(child=>branch(child,depth+1)).join('');return row+(closed?'':nested);}
 let html=all.filter(f=>!f.parent_id||!byId.has(f.parent_id)).map(f=>branch(f,0)).join('');for(const f of all)if(!seen.has(f.id))html+=branch(f,0);return html;
}

function automaticField(f,value){
 if(f.path.length!==1)return false;
 const k=f.path[0];
 if(['endpoint','base_url','host','ip'].includes(k)){
  if(typeof value!=='string'||value.length>2048)return false;
  if(k==='host'||k==='ip')return !/[\s@/?#]/.test(value);
  try{const u=new URL(value);return ['http:','https:'].includes(u.protocol)&&!u.username&&!u.password&&!u.search&&!u.hash;}catch{return false;}
 }
 return ['type','purpose','source','authentication_tested','port','database_type','region'].includes(k)&&(['boolean','number'].includes(typeof value)||typeof value==='string'&&value.length<=512);
}
// 字段颜色只表达含义，不把未知字段或密码错误标成故障状态。
function configurationFieldTone(field){
 const names=A(field.path).map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase());
 if(names.some(x=>/password|passwd|secret|token|private_key|passphrase|api_key|access_key|credential/.test(x)||x==='key'))return 'rose';
 if(names.some(x=>['target','endpoint','base_url','host','ip','port','url','uri','remote_path','connection_uri','brokers','endpoints'].includes(x)))return 'blue';
 if(names.some(x=>['account','username','user','owner','email'].includes(x)))return 'violet';
 if(names.some(x=>['service','kind','type','database','database_type','database_index','namespace','group','bucket','region','environment'].includes(x)))return 'teal';
 return 'slate';
}

let listSearchTimer;
function queueListSearch(event){
 s.query=event.target.value;clearTimeout(listSearchTimer);
 if(s.page==='knowledge'){s.seq++;abort?.abort();clearSnapshotPoll();}
 if(event.isComposing)return;
 listSearchTimer=setTimeout(()=>s.page==='knowledge'?load():render(),150);
}
function pendingSnapshot(){const snapshot=s.data.status?.snapshot;return !snapshot?.updated_at&&['pending','error'].includes(snapshot?.state);}
function clearSnapshotPoll(){clearTimeout(snapshotPollTimer);snapshotPollTimer=null;snapshotPollAttempts=0;}
function scheduleSnapshotPoll(page){const snapshot=s.data.status?.snapshot,planningRunning=page==='planning'&&A(s.data.tasks).some(t=>t.status==='running');if((!planningRunning&&(!snapshot||(!snapshot.refreshing&&snapshot.state!=='pending')||snapshotPollAttempts>=30))||document.hidden||s.detail||s.page!==page)return;clearTimeout(snapshotPollTimer);snapshotPollTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(!document.hidden&&s.page===page&&!s.detail){snapshotPollAttempts++;load({poll:true});}},planningRunning?5000:2000);}
function render(){
 const focused=document.activeElement?.id,selection=document.activeElement?.selectionStart;
 const scrolls=[...document.querySelectorAll('.directories')].map(x=>[x.scrollTop,x.scrollLeft]);
 const pageDetail=Boolean(s.detail);
 root.innerHTML=`${navigation()}<main data-module="${s.page}" aria-label="${E(PAGES[s.page])}" class="" aria-busy="${s.loading}">${pageDetail?detailView():''}${s.error?`<div class="error" role="alert">${E(s.error.replaceAll('请点击刷新读取','请重试'))} <button id="retry">重试</button></div>`:''}${!pageDetail?(s.loading&&!Object.keys(s.data).length?'<div class="loading" role="status">正在读取…</div>':pendingSnapshot()?`<div class="${s.data.status?.snapshot?.state==='error'?'error':'loading'}" role="status">${s.data.status?.snapshot?.state==='error'?'暂时无法读取可用数据，请重试。':'正在准备可用数据…'}</div>`:({accounts:accountView,other_accounts:otherAccountsView,agents:skillsView,models:modelsView,config:configView,projects:projectView,knowledge:knowledgeView,services:servicesView,connections:connectionsView,planning:()=>planningUI?.render('planning',s.data)||empty('工作计划尚未加载')}[s.page]||(()=>empty('暂无此页面数据')))()):''}</main><div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>`;
 bind();updateResetCountdown();document.querySelectorAll('.directories').forEach((x,i)=>{if(scrolls[i]){x.scrollTop=scrolls[i][0];x.scrollLeft=scrolls[i][1];}});
 if(focused&&focused!=='query')document.getElementById(focused)?.focus({preventScroll:true});
 if(focused==='query'){const q=document.getElementById('query');q?.focus();try{q?.setSelectionRange(selection,selection);}catch{}}
}

/** 默认按钮保留明确文案，不能选择未核验账户或重复提交。 */
function defaultAccountButton(account){
 if(account.is_default)return '';
 const busy=s.accountSaving===account.id,disabled=account.is_default||account.login_status!=='ready'||s.accountSaving!==null;
 return `<button id="account-default-${E(account.id)}" class="soft" data-account-default="${E(account.id)}" aria-label="${E(accountTitle(account))}：${account.is_default?'默认账户':'设为默认账户'}" ${disabled?'disabled':''} ${busy?'aria-busy="true"':''} title="${account.login_status==='ready'?'切换后，所有会话跟随当前默认账户':'账户未登录或身份尚未确认'}">${I('star')}${busy?'设置中…':account.is_default?'默认账户':'设为默认'}</button>`;
}
function defaultAccountMessage(result){
 return result?.applies_to==='all_sessions_current_default'&&result?.routing_ready===true
  ?'默认账户已切换，所有会话跟随当前默认账户'
  :'默认账户已保存；账户路由未就绪，尚未在 Codex 中生效';
}
/** 仅在服务端确认保存后更新标记；错误保持原选择，过期读取不得覆盖结果。 */
async function setDefaultAccount(id){
 const account=A(s.data.accounts).find(a=>a.id===id);
 if(s.page!=='accounts'||s.accountSaving!==null||!account||account.is_default||account.login_status!=='ready')return;
 const expected=A(s.data.accounts).find(a=>a.is_default)?.id??null;
 s.accountSaving=id;s.error='';s.seq++;abort?.abort();s.syncing=false;s.loading=false;render();
 let saved=false,notice='';
 try{
  const result=await bridge.tool('account_default',{id,expected_default_id:expected});
  if(result.default_account_id!==id)throw Error('默认账户保存结果无法确认，请刷新后查看');
  viewCache.delete(canonicalKey({view:'accounts'}));
  if(s.page==='accounts')s.data={...s.data,accounts:A(s.data.accounts).map(a=>({...a,is_default:a.id===result.default_account_id}))};
  saved=true;notice=defaultAccountMessage(result);
 }catch(error){
  if(s.page==='accounts')s.error=error.message;
 }finally{
  s.accountSaving=null;
  if(s.page==='accounts'){
   if(!A(s.data.accounts).length){load({refresh:true});return;}
   render();document.getElementById((saved?'account-title-':'account-default-')+id)?.focus({preventScroll:true});
   if(saved)message(notice);
  }
 }
}
async function load({cursor,session,refresh=false,poll=false}={}){
 if(s.page==='accounts'&&s.accountSaving!==null)return;
 if(s.usageRefreshing&&refresh)return;
 clearTimeout(snapshotPollTimer);snapshotPollTimer=null;if(!poll)snapshotPollAttempts=0;
 const seq=++s.seq;abort?.abort();abort=new AbortController();clearSecrets();s.error='';s.syncing=true;
 const page=s.page,usageRefresh=['accounts','other_accounts'].includes(page)&&refresh,shouldRefresh=refresh,args={view:page};
 if(['other_accounts','models'].includes(page))args.provider=page==='models'?s.modelProvider:s.accountProvider;
 if(['other_accounts','models','config'].includes(page))Object.assign(args,{query:s.query,kind:s.kind,folder:s.folder});

 if(page==='knowledge'){args.scope=s.scope;args.query=s.query;}
 const key=canonicalKey(args);let cached=viewCache.get(key),changed=false;
 const previous=s.data;
 // 回到页面立即使用公开缓存；缓存只保留在内存，不包含展开过的秘密详情。
 s.loading=!cached;s.usageRefreshing=usageRefresh;
 if(cached){s.data=cached.data;changed=previous!==s.data;}
 if(!cached||changed||usageRefresh)render();
 try{
  let response=await bridge.tool('workbench_sync',{...args,...(cached?{revision:cached.revision}:{}),refresh:shouldRefresh},abort.signal);
  if(seq!==s.seq||page!==s.page)return;
  if(cacheContext!==null&&cacheContext!==response.context){viewCache.clear();cached=null;s.data={};s.detail=null;clearSecrets();}
  cacheContext=response.context;
  if(!cached&&!response.reset){response=await bridge.tool('workbench_sync',{...args,refresh:shouldRefresh},abort.signal);if(seq!==s.seq||page!==s.page)return;}
  // 手动刷新只轮询本地快照；采集及原子 JSON 写入结束前不替换可见数据。
  if(usageRefresh){
   let attempt=0;
   while(applySync(cached,response).data.status?.snapshot?.refreshing){
    if(++attempt>120)throw Error('用量刷新尚未完成，已保留原数据，请稍后重试');
    await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,1000));
    if(seq!==s.seq||page!==s.page)return;
    response=await bridge.tool('workbench_sync',{...args,refresh:false},abort.signal);
    if(seq!==s.seq||page!==s.page)return;
    if(response.context!==cacheContext)throw Error('账户环境已变化，请重新打开页面');
   }
   const snapshot=applySync(cached,response).data.status?.snapshot;
   if(snapshot&&['stale','error'].includes(snapshot.state))throw Error(snapshot.error||'用量刷新失败，已保留原数据');
  }
  const next=applySync(cached,response);
  rememberView(key,next);
  let data=next.data;
  const shouldRender=!response.unchanged||changed||!cached||usageRefresh;
  s.data=data;
  if(page==='knowledge')s.scope=data.selected_scope||s.scope;
  if(page==='other_accounts'&&!(data.facets?.providers||accountProviders(data.accounts)).some(p=>p.id===s.accountProvider))s.accountProvider='';
  s.loading=false;s.syncing=false;s.usageRefreshing=false;
  if(shouldRender)render();scheduleSnapshotPoll(page);
 }catch(e){
  if(seq!==s.seq||e.name==='AbortError')return;
  s.error=e.message;s.loading=false;s.syncing=false;s.usageRefreshing=false;
  // 临时网络失败保留已读取内容并明确报错；失效许可才清空账户缓存。
  if(e.clearCache){viewCache.clear();s.data={};cacheContext=null;}else{s.data=cached?.data||previous;}
  clearSecrets();render();
 }finally{if(seq===s.seq){s.loading=false;s.syncing=false;s.usageRefreshing=false;}}
}
function pageChange(p){clearTimeout(listSearchTimer);clearSnapshotPoll();if(!Object.hasOwn(PAGES,p)||p===s.page)return;planningUI?.leave();s.seq++;if(!bridge.embedded)history.replaceState(null,'','/'+p);s.page=p;s.modelProvider='';s.detail=null;s.data={};s.query='';s.section='';s.project='';s.folder='';s.kind='';s.accountProvider='';s.session='';s.scope='global';clearSecrets();load();}
async function detail(kind,id,detailScope){clearSecrets();const epoch=s.detailSeq;s.error='';try{let value,entry,title;if(kind==='skill'){value=await bridge.tool('skill_detail',{id});title=skillTitle(value.skill);}else if(kind==='model'){value=await bridge.tool('model_detail',{id});entry=value.credential;title=chineseTitle(value.model.name,'模型');}else if(kind==='project'){value=await bridge.tool('project_detail',{id});title=value.project.name;}else if(kind==='knowledge'){value=await bridge.tool('knowledge_detail',{scope:detailScope||s.scope,key:id});title=chineseTitle(value.knowledge.title,'知识');}else{entry=A(s.data.entries).find(x=>x.id===id);if(!entry){const catalog=await bridge.tool('credential_list');entry=A(catalog.entries).find(x=>x.id===id);}if(!entry)throw Error('配置条目已变化');value={};title=entryTitle(entry);if(entry.model_id){value=await bridge.tool('model_detail',{id:entry.model_id});kind='model';entry=value.credential;}}if(epoch!==s.detailSeq)return;s.detail={kind,value,entry,title,fields:[],trigger:id};render();document.getElementById('back')?.focus();if(entry&&!document.hidden)await readSecret('fields');}catch(e){if(epoch===s.detailSeq){s.error=e.message;render();}}}
async function readSecret(action,index){const d=s.detail,entry=d?.entry||d?.value?.credential;if(!entry||s.fieldBusy)return;const epoch=s.detailSeq;s.fieldBusy=true;s.error='';if(action==='fields'){s.revealed.clear();d.fields=[];d.fieldsState='loading';}render();let request,payload;try{request=await ConfigurationCrypto.prepare(entry);const envelope=await bridge.tool('credential_details',request.arguments);payload=await ConfigurationCrypto.decrypt(request,envelope);if(epoch!==s.detailSeq||d!==s.detail||document.hidden)return;const data=payloadRoot(payload);if(action==='fields'){d.fields=fieldPaths(data);s.revealed.clear();for(const [i,f] of d.fields.entries()){const raw=f.path.reduce((v,k)=>v?.[k],data);f.autoVisible=d.kind==='config'||automaticField(f,raw);if(f.autoVisible)s.revealed.set(i,d.kind!=='config'&&typeof raw==='boolean'?(raw?'是':'否'):fieldValue(data,f.path));}d.fieldsState='ready';}else{const f=d.fields[index];if(!f)throw Error('字段不存在');const value=fieldValue(data,f.path);if(action==='copy'){if(!navigator.clipboard?.writeText)throw Error('当前环境不支持复制');await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);if(epoch===s.detailSeq)message('已复制');}else s.revealed.set(index,value);}}catch(e){if(epoch===s.detailSeq){s.error=e.message;if(action==='fields')d.fieldsState='error';}}finally{payload=null;if(request)request.privateKey=null;if(epoch===s.detailSeq){s.fieldBusy=false;render();if(action==='copy'&&!s.error)message('已复制');}}}
function bind(){
 if(s.page==='planning')planningUI?.bind(root,s.page,s.data);
 document.getElementById('skill-scope')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{s.kind=e.target.value;render();});
 document.getElementById('refresh-usage')?.addEventListener('click',()=>load({refresh:true}));
 document.getElementById('account-create')?.addEventListener('click',()=>createAccount());
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-account-login]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>loginAccount(button.dataset.accountLogin));
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-account-status]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>checkAccount(button.dataset.accountStatus));
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-account-default]').forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>setDefaultAccount(button.dataset.accountDefault));
 document.getElementById('model-provider')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{s.modelProvider=e.target.value;load();});
 document.getElementById('protocol-source')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const url=s.detail?.value?.api_contract?.source_url;if(typeof url==='string'&&url.startsWith('https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/'))bridge.openDocumentation(url).catch(e=>message(e.message));});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-group]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const g=GROUPS.find(x=>x.name===b.dataset.group);if(g&&!g.pages.includes(s.page))pageChange(g.pages[0]);});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(b.dataset.workbenchHome)planningUI?.home();if(b.dataset.page===s.page)render();else pageChange(b.dataset.page);});
document.getElementById('retry')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{s.detail=null;load({refresh:true});});
const query=document.getElementById('query');
query?.addEventListener('compositionstart',()=>{clearTimeout(listSearchTimer);if(s.page==='knowledge'){s.seq++;abort?.abort();clearSnapshotPoll();}});
query?.addEventListener('input',queueListSearch);
query?.addEventListener('compositionend',queueListSearch);
for(const kind of ['section','project'])document.getElementById(kind)?.addEventListener('change',e=>{s[kind]=e.target.value;if(kind==='section')s.project='';s.session='';load({session:''});});
document.getElementById('session')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{s.session=e.target.value;load({session:e.target.value});});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-provider]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{s.accountProvider=b.dataset.provider;render();});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-folder-toggle]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const id=b.dataset.folderToggle;s.collapsedFolders.has(id)?s.collapsedFolders.delete(id):s.collapsedFolders.add(id);render();});
document.getElementById('kind')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{s.kind=e.target.value;render();});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-folder]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{s.folder=b.dataset.folder;render();});
document.getElementById('clear-folder')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{s.folder='';render();});
for(const kind of ['skill','model','config','project'])document.querySelectorAll('[data-'+kind+']').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>detail(kind,b.dataset[kind]));
document.getElementById('project-section')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{s.section=e.target.value;render();});
document.getElementById('knowledge-scope')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{clearTimeout(listSearchTimer);s.scope=e.target.value;s.query='';load();});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-knowledge]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const item=s.data.knowledge[Number(b.dataset.knowledge)];detail('knowledge',item.knowledge_key,item.scope_key);});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-service]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=async()=>{try{const r=await bridge.tool('service_detail',{id:b.dataset.service});await detail(r.service.credential_id?'config':r.service.reference_kind==='model'?'model':'config',r.service.credential_id||r.service.reference_id);}catch(e){s.error=e.message;render();}});
document.getElementById('back')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const trigger=s.detail?.trigger;clearSecrets();s.detail=null;s.error='';render();(document.getElementById('config-entry-'+trigger)||[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-config]')].find(b=>b.dataset.config===trigger))?.focus({preventScroll:true});});
document.getElementById('open-native')?.addEventListener('click',()=>bridge.open(s.detail.value.native_url).catch(e=>{s.error=e.message;render();}));document.getElementById('fields')?.addEventListener('click',()=>readSecret('fields'));document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const n=Number(b.dataset.reveal);if(s.revealed.has(n)){s.revealed.delete(n);render();}else readSecret('view',n);});document.querySelectorAll('[data-copy]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>readSecret('copy',Number(b.dataset.copy)));}
window.__workbenchReadonlyTest={providerStyle,accountProviders,accountUsage,otherAccountCard,otherAccountsView,modelProviders,compactModelSearch,modelMatches,modelsView,CARD_THEMES,SKILL_THEMES,skillTheme,knowledgeTheme,cardSymbol,chineseTitle,skillTitle,accountTitle,avatarMarkup,accountView,resetAnalysisView,resetCountdown,setQuery:value=>{s.query=String(value??'');},skillsView,entryTitle,folderPath,filteredConfigurations,configType,configTypeLabel,orderedAccounts,automaticField,nativeUrl,duration,resetTime,findText,payloadRoot,fieldPaths,fieldValue,foldersIn,readResult,color,entityIcon,entityTag,applySync,canonicalKey,timestamp,recordTimestamp,newestRecords,pendingSnapshot,defaultAccountMessage};
// 隐藏时只清理秘密，公共目录读取继续收尾；避免取消后永远停在忙状态。
window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{clearSnapshotPoll();s.seq++;abort?.abort();s.loading=false;s.syncing=false;clearSecrets();render();clearTimeout(resetCountdownTimer);resetCountdownTimer=null;});

const bootstrapped=installBootstrap();
if(root&&bootstrapped){render();if(Object.keys(s.data).length)load();}
if(root)bridge.initialize().then(()=>{if(!bootstrapped&&!s.syncing&&!Object.keys(s.data).length)load();}).catch(e=>{if(!bootstrapped){s.error=e.message;render();}});
})();
